gitCommit.subject: Fix/qa test gen browser install lockfile (#109)
gitCommit.body:
Fix/qa test gen browser install lockfile (#109)

* Fix MCP browser/version mismatch in qa-test-generation.yml

@playwright/mcp@latest bumped to an alpha playwright build (0.0.81,
2026-09-14) whose default Chromium build outran what the workflow's
separate, unpinned `npx playwright install` step fetches (latest-stable
trails the MCP's alpha pin). Install @playwright/mcp first so the
browser-install step resolves its own bundled playwright instead of an
independently-resolved "latest", keeping the two from drifting apart
regardless of future version bumps on either side.

Root-caused from run #8 (https://github.com/MastahKitz/playwright-fullstack-test-framework/actions/runs/35079886799),
which blocked before writing any test code because the MCP server's
browser (chromium-1244) wasn't installed (only chromium-1243 was).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Fix MCP browser install being clobbered by repo's own lockfile

The previous fix (installing @playwright/mcp before the browser-install
step) ran `npm install` inside the repo checkout, which — unlike a bare
`npx` — honors this repo's own committed package-lock.json. That lockfile
already pins an old `playwright` (via @playwright/test), so `npm install`
silently resolved @playwright/mcp's browser install against that old
pinned version instead of @playwright/mcp's own newer one, installing yet
another mismatched Chromium build. Confirmed by reproducing the exact repo
state locally.

Run the install in $RUNNER_TEMP instead, outside the repo checkout, so
there's no lockfile in scope to interfere — verified locally that this
resolves @playwright/mcp's actual pinned playwright-core version
correctly (chromium-1244, matching what the MCP server needs at runtime).

Root-caused from run #9 (https://github.com/MastahKitz/playwright-fullstack-test-framework/actions/runs/35086175838),
which still blocked on a missing browser despite run #8's fix landing.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* increased threshold to 0.8
increased timeout to 30mins

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
